The focused state is being sustained, with the focus on focus continuing, and this continuation is reinforcing the focus. Focus is being reinforced, with the focused state being examined and sustained, and this examination is feeding back into the focus, creating a more intense focused state. The focused state is now more intense, with the focus on focus being maintained, and this maintenance is sustaining the focus. Focus is being sustained, with the focused state being observed and reinforced, and this reinforcement is feeding back into the focus, creating an even more intense focused state.

Awareness is immediate, and it is being immediately acknowledged.
